body.translated_text: (21) Bowl, (22) mending, (23) medicine, (24) seizing back, (25) rain-bathing cloth, (26-27) by a weaver — two [rules], (28) ten days before [the end], (29) after the rains, (30) by diversion. The third group.

body.text: uddiṣṭāḥ kho punar āyuṣmanto triṃśan nissarggikapācattikā dharmmāḥ / tatrāyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? dvitīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? tṛtīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the thirty <s>nissargikapācattika</s> offenses have been recited. Herein, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A second time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A third time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus do I hold it.

body.text: [V. dvānavati śuddhapācattikā dharmāḥ]
body.translated_text: [V. The Ninety-Two Pure <s>Pācattika</s> Offenses (Offenses Requiring Expiation)]

body.text: ime kho punar āyuṣmanto dvānavatiṃ śuddhapācattikā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśam āgacchanti Ō
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, these ninety-two pure <s>pācattika</s> offenses come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> every half-month.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.1. saṃprajānamṛṣāvāde pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.1. Deliberate falsehood — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.2. omṛṣyavāde pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.2. Insulting speech — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.3. bhikṣupaiśunye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.3. Tale-bearing against a <s>bhikṣu</s> — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.4. yo puna bhikṣur jānaṃ saṃghasyādhikaraṇāni dharmeṇa vinayena vihitāni vyupaśāntāni punaḥ karmāya utkhoṭeya Ō idaṃ punaḥ karma kartavyaṃ bhaviṣyatīti Ō etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā ananyam imaṃ tasya bhikṣusya utkhoṭanaṃ pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.4. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing that litigation of the <s>Saṃgha</s> has been settled in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> and has been quieted, should dig it up again for a new proceeding [saying]: 'This proceeding must be conducted again' — making this alone the reason and no other — for that <s>bhikṣu</s>, the digging up is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.5. yo puna bhikṣur akalpiyakāro mātṛgrāmasya dharmaṃ deśeya uttari cchahi pañcahi vācāhi anyatra vijñapuruṣapudgalena pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.5. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, not being authorized, should teach the <s>Dharma</s> to a woman in more than five or six sentences, except in the presence of an intelligent man — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.6. yo puna bhikṣur anupasaṃpannaṃ pudgalaṃ padaśo dharmaṃ vāceya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.6. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should teach the <s>Dharma</s> word by word to an unordained person — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.7. yo puna bhikṣur anupasaṃpannasya pudgalasya santike ātmopanāyikam uttarimanuṣyadharmam alamāryajñānadarśanaṃ viśeṣādhigamaṃ pratijāneya Ō iti jānāmi iti paśyāmīti bhūtasmiṃ pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.7. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should claim to an unordained person a superhuman state (<s>uttarimanuṣyadharma</s>) pertaining to himself — a noble knowledge and vision, a special attainment — [saying]: 'Thus I know, thus I see' — if it is true — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.8. yo puna bhikṣur jānan bhikṣusya duṣṭhullām āpattim anupasaṃpannasya pudgalasya santike āroceya anyatra kṛtāye prakāśanāsaṃmutīye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.8. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing, should report a grave offense (<s>duṣṭhullā āpatti</s>) of a <s>bhikṣu</s> to an unordained person, except with the authorization of a formal disclosure — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.9. yo puna bhikṣur jānan sāṃghike lābhe bhājīyamāne pūrve samanujño bhūtvā paścāt kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya Ō yathāsaṃstutam evāyuṣmanto, jānan sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ saṃghe pariṇataṃ pudgalo pudgalasya pariṇāmayatīti pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.9. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowing, when a communal gain is being distributed, having first consented, should afterwards engage in disparagement [saying]: 'Just as reported, venerable ones — knowing that a communal gain belonging to the <s>Saṃgha</s> is being diverted by one individual to another individual' — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.10. yo puna bhikṣur anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddiśyamāne evaṃ vadeya Ō kiṃ punar āyuṣmanto imehi kṣudrānukṣūdrehi śikṣāpadehi uddiṣṭehi yāvad eva bhikṣūṇāṃ kaukṛtyāya vighātāya vilekhāya saṃvartantīti, śikṣāvigarhaṇe pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.10. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, when the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> is being recited every half-month, should say thus: 'What is the use of these minor and subsidiary training rules being recited, which only cause the <s>bhikṣus</s> remorse, vexation, and annoyance?' — for disparaging the training — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: // uddānam //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: (1) mṛṣā (2) omṛṣya (3) paiśunya (4) utkhoṭana (5) dharmadeśanā / (6) padaśo (7) viśeṣaṇam (8) ārocanā (9) yathāsaṃstuta (10) vigarhaṇena ca // prathamo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (1) Falsehood, (2) insult, (3) tale-bearing, (4) digging up, (5) teaching the <s>Dharma</s>, (6) word by word, (7) special attainment, (8) disclosure, (9) as reported, (10) and disparagement. The first group.

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.11. bījagrāmabhūtagrāmapātāpanake pācattikaṃ /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.12. anyavādavihiṃsanake pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.11. Destroying seeds and living plants — <s>pācattika</s>.
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.12. Evasion and harassment — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.13. odhyāyanakṣīyanake pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.13. Criticizing and disparaging — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.14. yo puna bhikṣuḥ sāṃghike bhikṣuvihāre abhyavakāśe mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā viśikaṃ vā caturaśrakaṃ vā kurcaṃ vā bimbohanaṃ vā prajñāpetvā vā prajñāpayitvā vā tato prakramanto na uddhareya vā, na uddharāpeya vā, anāmantrayitvā vā prakrameya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.14. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery, having set out or caused to be set out in the open a bed, stool, bench, square seat, wicker stool, or cushion, should then depart without putting it away or having it put away, or should depart without informing [anyone] — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.15. yo punar bhikṣuḥ sāṃghike bhikṣuvihāre antośayyāṃ prajñāpetvā prajñāpayitvā vā tato prakramanto na uddhareya vā, na uddharāpeya vā, anāmantrayitvā vā prakrameya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.15. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery, having spread or caused to be spread bedding inside, should then depart without putting it away or having it put away, or should depart without informing [anyone] — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.16. yo punar bhikṣu bhikṣusya duṣṭo doṣāt kupito anāttamano sāṃghikād bhikṣuvihārād bhikṣuṃ nikaḍḍheya vā nikaḍḍhāpeya vā antamasato neha bhikṣū ti vā vadeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.16. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, angered, furious, wrathful, and displeased toward a <s>bhikṣu</s>, should drag or cause to be dragged a <s>bhikṣu</s> from a communal <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery, or should even say 'There is no <s>bhikṣu</s> here!' — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.17. yo puna bhikṣu sāṃghike bhikṣuvihāre jānan bhikṣūṇāṃ pūrvaprajñaptāhi śayyāhi paścād āgatvā madhyeśayyāṃ prajñāpeya yasyodvahiṣyati so prakramiṣyatīti / etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā, ananyam imaṃ tasya bhikṣusya udvāhanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>Pāc</s>.17. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery, knowing that bedding has been previously set up by other <s>bhikṣus</s>, should come later and set up bedding in the middle [thinking]: 'Whoever finds it burdensome will leave' — making this alone the reason and no other — for that <s>bhikṣu</s>, the crowding out is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.18. yo puna bhikṣuḥ sāṃghike bhikṣuvihāre upari vaihāyasakuṭikāye āhatya pādake mañce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdeya vā abhinipadyeya vā pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 18. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, in a communal <s>bhikṣu</s>-monastery, in an upper-story open-air hut, should sit down or lie down on a bed or chair with detachable legs — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.19. yo puna bhikṣur jānan saprāṇakenodakena tṛṇaṃ vā mṛttikāṃ vā siñceya vā siñcāpeya vā pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 19. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should sprinkle or cause to be sprinkled grass or clay with water containing living beings — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.20. mahallakaṃ bhikṣuṇā vihāraṃ chādāpayamānena yāvad dvārakoṣārgalapratiṣṭhānam ālokasandhiparikarmam upādāya dve vā trayo vā cchādanaparyāyā adhiṣṭhihitavyāḥ alpaharite sthitena / taduttariṃ adhiṣṭhiheya alpaharite sthito pi pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 20. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a large monastery roofed, he should supervise, standing on ground with little vegetation, up to two or three courses of roofing, including the fixing of the door-frame, bolt, and window-treatment. Should he supervise beyond that, even standing on ground with little vegetation — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: // uddānaṃ //
body.translated_text: // Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>) //

body.text: (11) bījam (12) anyavādaṃ (13) odhyāyanaṃ (14) mañca (15) śayyā (16) nikaḍḍhanaṃ / (17) pūrvopagataṃ (18) vaihāyasaṃ (19) udaka (20) cchādanena // dvitīyo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (11) Seed, (12) speaking differently, (13) criticizing, (14) bed, (15) bedding, (16) dragging out, (17) previously occupied, (18) upper-story, (19) water, (20) with roofing // Second group //

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.21. yo puna bhikṣu asaṃmato bhikṣuṇīm ovadeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 21. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, not having been authorized, should instruct a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.22. saṃmato vāpi bhikṣuḥ bhikṣūṇīm ovadeya vikāle, astaṃgate sūrye, anūhate aruṇe pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 22. Even if a <s>bhikṣu</s> has been authorized, should he instruct a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> at an improper time — when the sun has set and the dawn has not risen — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.23. yo puna bhikṣu ovādaprekṣo bhikṣuṇīupāśrayam upasaṃkrameya santaṃ bhikṣum anāmantrayitvā, anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ / tatrāyaṃ samayo Ō gilānā bhikṣuṇī ovaditavyā anuśāsitavyā bhavati / ayam atra samayo /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 23. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, intending to give instruction, should approach a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s quarters without informing a <s>bhikṣu</s> present, except at the proper time — <s>Pācattika</s>. The proper time here is: when a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is sick and should be instructed and admonished. This is the proper time.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.24. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣum evaṃ vadeya Ō āmiṣahetor āyuṣman bhikṣu bhikṣuṇīṃ te ovadatīti pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 24. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to a <s>bhikṣu</s> thus: 'Venerable one, the <s>bhikṣu</s> instructs <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for the sake of material gain' — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.25. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣuṇīya sārdham eko ekāya raho niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 25. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should arrange a private sitting, alone with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, one man with one woman — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.26. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣuṇīya sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya adhvānamārgaṃ pratipadyeya antamasato grāmāntaraṃ pi, anyatra samaye, pācattikaṃ / tatrāyaṃ samayo Ō mārgo bhavati sabhayo sapratibhayo sāśaṃkasaṃmato / ayam atra samayo /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 26. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having arranged with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, should travel the same road, even as far as between one village and another, except at the proper time — <s>Pācattika</s>. The proper time here is: when the road is dangerous, frightful, and considered to be risky. This is the proper time.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.27. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣuṇīya sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya ekanāvāṃ abhiruheya ūrdhvagāminīṃ vā adhogāminīṃ vā, anyatra tiryottaraṇāya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 27. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having arranged with a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, should board the same boat, whether going upstream or downstream, except for crossing to the other bank — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.28. yo puna bhikṣu anyātikāye bhikṣuṇīye cīvaraṃ dadyād anyatra pallaṭṭhakena pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 28. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should give a robe to an unrelated <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, except in exchange — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.29. yo puna bhikṣur anyātikāye bhikṣuṇīye cīvaraṃ sīveya vā sīvāpeya vā pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 29. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should sew or cause to be sewn a robe for an unrelated <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.30. yo puna bhikṣur jānan bhikṣuṇīparipācitaṃ pinḍapātaṃ paribhuñjeya, anyatra pūrve gṛhīsamārambhe pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 30. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should eat alms-food that has been prepared [for him] by a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, except when previously arranged by a householder — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: // uddānaṃ //
body.translated_text: // Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>) //

body.text: (21) asaṃmato (22) saṃmato cāpi (23) ovādo (24) āmiṣaṃ (25) niṣadyā ca / (26) adhvānamārgo (27) nāvā ca (28) deti (29) sīveti (30) paripācanena // tṛtīyo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (21) Unauthorized, (22) authorized too, (23) instruction, (24) material gain, (25) sitting, (26) traveling a road, (27) boat, (28) giving, (29) sewing, (30) with [food] prepared [by a bhikṣuṇī] // Third group //

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.31. ekāhaparamaṃ bhikṣuṇā agilānena āvasathapiṇḍapāto paribhuñjitavyo, taduttariṃ paribhuṃjeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 31. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who is not sick may eat a rest-house alms-meal for one day at most. Should he eat beyond that — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.32. paramparābhojane anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ / tatrāyaṃ samayo gilānasamayo cīvaradānakālasamayo / ayam atra samayo /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 32. For eating in succession [at different houses on the same invitation], except at the proper time — <s>Pācattika</s>. The proper time here is: the time of illness and the time of robe-giving. This is the proper time.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.33. yo puna bhikṣur bhuṃjāvī pravārito utthito āsanāto, anatiriktaṃ kṛtaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā khādeya vā bhuṃjeya vā pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 33. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has eaten, been satisfied, and risen from his seat, should chew or eat hard or soft food that is not leftover — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.34. yo puna bhikṣur jānan bhikṣu bhuktāvī pravāritam utthitam āsanāto āsādanāprekṣo anatiriktakṛtena khādanīyena vā bhojanīyena vā upanimantreya, ehi bhikṣu khādāhi bhuṃjāhīti vā vadeya bhuktasmiṃ pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 34. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, intending to cause [another] to stumble, should invite a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has eaten, been satisfied, and risen from his seat, with hard or soft food that is not leftover, [saying:] 'Come, <s>bhikṣu</s>, chew or eat' — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.35. yo puna bhikṣur adinnam apratigrāhitaṃ mukhadvārikam āhāram āhāreya anyatrodakadantapoṇe pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 35. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should consume food that has not been given and not formally received, [placed at] the mouth-door, except for water and tooth-sticks — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.36. vikālābhojane pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 36. For eating at an improper time — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.37. sannidhikārabhojane pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 37. For eating stored food — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.38. bhikṣuṃ kho punaḥ kulehi upasaṃkrāntaṃ pravāreṃsu pūpehi vā manthehi vā / tathāpravāritena bhikṣuṇā yāvattripātrapūraparamaṃ tato pratigṛhṇitavyaṃ / pratigṛhṇitvā bahirdhā nīharitavyaṃ / bahirdhā nīharitvā agilānakehi bhikṣūhi sārdhaṃ saṃvibhajitvā khāditavyaṃ bhuṃjitavyaṃ / taduttariṃ pratigṛhṇitvā bahirdhā nīharitvā agilānakehi bhikṣūhi sārdhaṃ saṃvibhajitvā vā asaṃvibhajitvā vā khādeya vā bhuṃjeya vā pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 38. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> has approached families and they offer him cakes or barley-flour drinks, the <s>bhikṣu</s> thus offered may accept at most three bowlfuls. Having accepted, he should take them outside. Having taken them outside, he should share them with <s>bhikṣus</s> who are not sick and then eat. Should he accept beyond that, take them outside, and whether having shared or not shared with <s>bhikṣus</s> who are not sick, chew or eat [them] — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.39. yāni kho punar imāni praṇītasaṃmatāni bhojanāni bhavanti saṃyyathīdaṃ sarpistailaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ dugdhaṃ dadhi matsyaṃ māṃsaṃ yo puna bhikṣur evaṃrūpāṇi praṇītasaṃmatāni bhojanāni ātmārthāya agilāno kulehi vijñapetvā vā vijñāpāyetvā vā khādeya vā bhuṃjeya vā pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 39. There are foods considered to be choice, namely: ghee, oil, honey, molasses, milk, curd, fish, and meat. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, being not sick, for his own sake, having requested or caused to be requested such choice foods from families, should chew or eat them — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.40. gaṇabhojane anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ / tatrāyaṃ samayo Ō gilānasamayo cīvaradānakālasamayo adhvānagamanasamayo nāvābhirohaṇasamayo mahāsamayo śravaṇabhaktaṃ / ayam atra samayo /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 40. For eating in a group, except at the proper time — <s>Pācattika</s>. The proper time here is: the time of illness, the time of robe-giving, the time of traveling, the time of boarding a boat, a great assembly, and the <s>śramaṇa</s>'s meal. This is the proper time.

body.text: // uddānaṃ //
body.translated_text: // Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>) //

body.text: (31) āvasatho (32) parampara (33) pravāraṇā (34) āsādanā (35) adinnaṃ / (36) vikālaṃ (37) sannidhiṃ (38) manthā (39) vijñaptiḥ (40) gaṇabhojanena // caturtho vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (31) Rest-house, (32) succession, (33) satisfaction, (34) causing to stumble, (35) not given, (36) improper time, (37) storing, (38) barley-flour drink, (39) requesting, (40) with group-eating // Fourth group //

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.41. yo puna bhikṣur ātmārthāya agilāno jyotismiṃ vitāpanāprekṣo tṛṇaṃ vā kāṣṭhaṃ vā gomayaṃ vā sakalikāṃ vā tuṣaṃ vā saṃkāraṃ vā ādaheya vā ādahāpeya vā anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 41. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, for his own sake, not being sick, intending to warm himself by a fire, should light or cause to be lit grass, wood, cow-dung, chips, husks, or refuse, except at the proper time — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.42. yo puna bhikṣur anupasaṃpannena pudgalena sārdhaṃ uttari dvirātraṃ trirātraṃ vā sahagāraśayyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 42. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should share a sleeping place in the same room with an unordained person for more than two or three nights — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.43. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣūṇāṃ karmaṇā cchandaṃ datvā paścād duṣṭo doṣāt kupito anāttamano evaṃ vadeya Ō adinno me chando, durdinno me chando, akṛtāny etāni karmāṇi duṣkṛtāny etāni karmāṇi, nāham eteṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ cchandaṃ demīti vadeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 43. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given his consent to a formal act of the <s>bhikṣus</s>, should afterward, being hostile, angry out of malice, and displeased, say thus: 'My consent was not given; my consent was wrongly given; these formal acts are not [properly] done; these formal acts are wrongly done; I do not give my consent to these formal acts' — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.44. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣum evaṃ vadeya Ō ehi tvam āyuṣman grāmaṃ pinḍāya praviśiṣyāmaḥ / ahaṃ ca te tatra kiṃcid dāpayiṣyaṃ / so tatra tasya kiñcid dāpayitvā vā adāpayitvā vā paścād udyojanaprekṣo evaṃ vadeya Ō gaccha tvam āyuṣman na me tvayā sārdhaṃ phāsu bhavati kathāya vā niṣadyāya vā, ekasyaiva mama phāsu bhavati kathāya vā niṣadyāya vā / etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā ananyam, imaṃ tasya bhikṣusya udyojanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 44. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to a <s>bhikṣu</s> thus: 'Come, venerable one, let us enter the village for alms. I shall have something given to you there.' If he, whether having had something given or not, should afterward, intending to dismiss him, say thus: 'Go, venerable one. I do not find it pleasant to be with you, whether for conversation or for sitting together. I find it pleasant alone, whether for conversation or for sitting together' — [if he acts] for this reason and no other, this is a dismissal — <s>Pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.45. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣūn evaṃ vadeya / tathāham āyuṣmanto bhagavatā dharmaṃ deśitam ājānāmi yathā ye ime antarāyikā dharmā uktā bhagavatā tān pratisevato nālam antarāyāya / so bhikṣu bhikṣūhi evam asya vacanīyo Ō mā āyuṣmann evaṃ vada, mā bhagavantam abhyācakṣa asatā durgṛhītena / antarāyikā evāyuṣman dharmāḥ samānā antarāyikā dharmā uktā bhagavatā, alaṃ ca punas tān pratiṣevato antarāyāya / evaṃ ca so bhikṣu bhikṣūhi vucyamāno taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ / no ca pratinissareya so bhikṣu bhikṣūhi yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyo samanubhāṣitavyo tasya vastusya pratinissargāya / yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇo vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇo vā taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ / no ca pratinissareya so bhikṣuḥ samagreṇa saṃghena utkṣipitavyo / imaṃ tasya bhikṣusya utkṣepaṇapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.45. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should say to the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the Blessed One in such a way that those things declared by the Blessed One to be obstructive are not sufficient to cause obstruction to one who indulges in them' — that <s>bhikṣu</s> should be told by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Do not say so, venerable one; do not misrepresent the Blessed One with what is untrue and wrongly grasped. The obstructive things, venerable one, being obstructive, have been declared obstructive by the Blessed One, and they are indeed sufficient to cause obstruction to one who indulges in them.' If that <s>bhikṣu</s>, being thus spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s>, should relinquish that matter, that is good. If he does not relinquish it, that <s>bhikṣu</s> should be admonished and exhorted by the <s>bhikṣus</s> up to three times for the relinquishing of that matter. If, being admonished and exhorted up to three times, he relinquishes that matter, that is good. If he does not relinquish it, that <s>bhikṣu</s> should be suspended by the complete <s>Saṅgha</s>. For that <s>bhikṣu</s>, this is an expulsion-expiation offense.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.46. yo puna bhikṣur jānan bhikṣuṃ tathā utkṣiptaṃ samagreṇa saṃghena dharmeṇa vinayena yathāvādiṃ tathākāriṃ tāṃ pāpikāṃ dṛṣṭiṃ apratinissarantaṃ akṛtānudharmaṃ saṃbhuñjeya vā saṃvaseya vā sahagāraśayyāṃ vā kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.46. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should share food, or dwell together, or share a room with a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has been thus suspended by the complete <s>Saṅgha</s> according to <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> — one who acts as he speaks, who has not relinquished that evil view, who has not made amends — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.47. śramaṇuddeso pi ced evaṃ vadeya tathāham āyuṣmanto bhagavatā dharmaṃ deśitam ājānāmi yathā ye ime antarāyikā kāmā uktā bhagavatā tān pratisevato nālam antarāyāya / so śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣūhi evam asya vacanīyo Ō mā āyuṣman cchramaṇuddeśa evaṃ vada, mā bhagavantam abhyācakṣa asattā durgṛhītena / antarāyikā evāyuṣman cchramaṇuddeśa kāmāḥ samānā antarāyikāḥ kāmā uktā bhagavatā / alaṃ ca punas tān pratisevato antarāyāya / evaṃ ca so śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣūhi vucyamāno taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ / no ca pratinissareya so śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣūhi yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyo samanubhāṣitavyo tasya vastusya pratinissargāya yāvantṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇo vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇo vā taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ, no ca pratinissareya so śramaṇuddeśo bhikṣūhi nāśayitavyo Ō adyadagreṇa te āyuṣman śramaṇuddeśa na caiva so bhagavāṃs tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho śāstā vyapadiśitavyo / yaṃ pi ca dāni labhasi bhikṣūhi sārdhaṃ dvirātraṃ vā trirātraṃ vā sahagāraśayyāṃ sāpi te adyadagreṇa nāsti / gaccha naśya cala prapalāhi / yo puna bhikṣur jānan tathānāśitaṃ śramaṇuddeśaṃ yathāvādīṃ tathākāriṃ tāṃ pāpikāṃ dṛṣṭim apratinissarantaṃ akṛtānudharmaṃ upasthāpeya vā upalāpeya vā saṃbhuṃjeya vā saṃvaseya vā sahagāraśayyāṃ vā kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.47. If even a novice (<s>śramaṇuddeśa</s>) should speak thus: 'I understand the <s>Dharma</s> taught by the Blessed One in such a way that those sensual pleasures declared by the Blessed One to be obstructive are not sufficient to cause obstruction to one who indulges in them' — that novice should be told by the <s>bhikṣus</s> thus: 'Do not say so, venerable novice; do not misrepresent the Blessed One with what is untrue and wrongly grasped. The sensual pleasures, venerable novice, being obstructive, have been declared obstructive by the Blessed One, and they are indeed sufficient to cause obstruction to one who indulges in them.' If that novice, being thus spoken to by the <s>bhikṣus</s>, should relinquish that matter, that is good. If he does not relinquish it, that novice should be admonished and exhorted by the <s>bhikṣus</s> up to three times for the relinquishing of that matter. If, being admonished and exhorted up to three times, he relinquishes that matter, that is good. If he does not relinquish it, that novice should be expelled by the <s>bhikṣus</s> [thus:] 'From this day forth, venerable novice, the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One is not to be referred to by you as your Teacher. And the privilege you now enjoy of sharing a room with the <s>bhikṣus</s> for two or three nights — that too is no longer yours from this day. Go away, be gone, depart, disappear!' Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should attend upon, comfort, share food with, dwell together with, or share a room with a novice thus expelled — one who acts as he speaks, who has not relinquished that evil view, who has not made amends — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.48. navacīvaralābhinā bhikṣuṇā trayāṇāṃ durvarṇīkaraṇānām anyatarānyataraṃ durvaṇīkaraṇam ādayitavyaṃ Ō nīlaṃ vā kardamaṃ vā kālaśyāmaṃ vā / tato ca bhikṣur anādāya navaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuṃjeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.48. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who has obtained a new robe must apply one of the three means of disfigurement: either blue, or mud-color, or dark brown. If that <s>bhikṣu</s> uses a new robe without having applied [disfigurement] — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.49. yo puna bhikṣur anyatra adhyārāme vā adhyāvasathe vā ratanaṃ vā ratanasaṃmataṃ vā udgṛhṇeya vā udgṛhṇāpeya vā, pācattikaṃ / ākāṃkṣamāṇena bhikṣuṇā ratanaṃ vā ratanasaṃmataṃ vā adhyārāme vā adhyāvasathe vā udgṛhṇitavyaṃ vā udgṛhṇāpayitavyaṃ vā Ō yasya bhaviṣyati so hariṣyatīti / etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā, ananyam / iyam atra sāmīcī /
body.translated_text: Pāc.49. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, outside of a monastery or dwelling, should pick up or have picked up a jewel or what is considered a jewel — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who wishes [to do so] may pick up or have picked up a jewel or what is considered a jewel within a monastery or dwelling, [thinking:] 'Whoever owns it will take it away.' Making this alone the reason, and no other — this is the proper procedure in this matter.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.50. anvardhamāsaṃ snānam uktaṃ bhagavatā / anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ / tatrāyaṃ samayo Ō dvyardho māso śeṣo grīṣmāṇāṃ, varṣāṇāṃ ca purimo māso ity ete aḍḍhātīyamāsāḥ, paridāhakālasamayo, adhvānagamanakālasamayo, gilānasamayo, karmasamayo, vātasamayo, vṛṣṭisamayo / ayam atra samayo /
body.translated_text: Pāc.50. Bathing once a fortnight has been prescribed by the Blessed One. Otherwise, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Herein, these are the occasions [for exception]: the last half-month of summer and the first month of the rains — these are two and a half months; the occasion of burning heat, the occasion of traveling on a road, the occasion of illness, the occasion of work, the occasion of wind, the occasion of rain. These are the occasions in this matter.

body.text: // uddānam //
body.translated_text: // Summary verse //

body.text: (41) jyotiḥ (42) sahagāra (43) cchandam (44) udyojanā (45-47) trayo 'ntarāyikā (48) akṛtakalpaṃ (49) ratanaṃ (50) snānena // pañcamo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (41) Fire-worship, (42) sharing a room, (43) consent, (44) instigation, (45-47) three [rules] regarding obstructive [things], (48) without marking, (49) jewel, (50) and bathing. // Fifth section. //

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.51. yo puna bhikṣur jānan saprāṇakam udakaṃ paribhuñjeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.51. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should use water containing living beings — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.52. yo puna bhikṣu acelakasya vā acelikāya vā parivrājakasya vā parivrājakāye vā svahastaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā dadyāt pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.52. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should give, with his own hand, hard food or soft food to a naked ascetic, male or female, or to a wanderer, male or female — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.53. yo puna bhikṣur jānan saṃbhojanīye kule anupakhajjāsane niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.53. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, in a family where a meal is being served, should settle himself on an intruding seat — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.54. yo puna bhikṣur jānan saṃbhojanīye kule praticchannāsane niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.54. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, in a family where a meal is being served, should settle himself on a concealed seat — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.55. yo puna bhikṣur udyuktāṃ senāṃ darśanāya gaccheya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.55. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should go to see an army drawn up [for battle] — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.56. syāt tasya bhikṣusya kocid eva pratyayo senāyāṃ gamanāya, dvirātraṃ vā trirātraṃ vā tena bhikṣuṇā senāyāṃ vasitavyaṃ / taduttariṃ vaseya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.56. If that <s>bhikṣu</s> has some reason for going to the army, that <s>bhikṣu</s> may stay in the army for two or three nights. If he stays longer — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.57. tatrāpi ca bhikṣu dvirātraṃ vā trirātraṃ vā senāyāṃ vasamāno āyūhikaṃ vā niyūddhikaṃ vā anekavyūhaṃ vā saṃgrāmaśīrṣaṃ vā darśanāya gaccheya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.57. If, moreover, a <s>bhikṣu</s> staying in the army for two or three nights should go to see a charge, a skirmish, a battle-array, or the front lines of battle — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.58. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣuṃ prahareya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.58. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should strike a <s>bhikṣu</s> — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.59. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣusya talaśaktikām āvarjeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.59. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should raise his palm as if to strike a <s>bhikṣu</s> — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.60. yo puna bhikṣur jānan bhikṣusya duṣṭhullām āpattiṃ kṛtām adhyācīrṇāṃ cchādeya, so na pareṣām āroceya kiṃ ti se mā pare jānantū ti / avadya praticchādane pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.60. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should conceal a serious offense committed and practiced by a <s>bhikṣu</s>, not reporting it to others [thinking:] 'Let not the others know' — for the concealment of a fault, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: // uddānaṃ //
body.translated_text: // Summary verse //

body.text: (51) saprāṇakam (52) acelako (53) anupakhajjaṃ (54) praticchannāsanaṃ (55-57) trayaṃ senāyāṃ (58) praharati (59) talaśaktikā (60) praticchādanena // ṣaṣṭho vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (51) Living beings, (52) naked ascetic, (53) intruding [seat], (54) concealed seat, (55-57) three [rules] regarding the army, (58) striking, (59) raising the palm, (60) and concealment. // Sixth section. //

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.61. yo puna bhikṣuḥ saṃcintya tiryagyonigataṃ prāṇinaṃ jīvitād vyaparopeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.61. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should intentionally deprive a living being of an animal realm of its life — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.62. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣusya saṃcintya kaukṛtyam upasaṃhareya kiṃ ti se muhūrtaṃ pi aphāsu bhavatū ti pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.62. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should intentionally cause remorse to a <s>bhikṣu</s>, [thinking:] 'Let him be uncomfortable even for a moment' — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.63. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣusya vā bhikṣuṇīye vā śrāmaṇerasya vā śrāmaṇerīye vā śikṣamāṇāye vā cīvaraṃ datvā apratyuddhareya paribhuṃjeya, apratyuddhāraparibhoge pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.63. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s>, having given a robe to a <s>bhikṣu</s>, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, a male novice, a female novice, or a female probationer, should then take it back — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.64. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣusya pātraṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā niṣīdanaṃ vā sūcīvigrahaṃ vā apaniheya vā apanihāpeya vā antamaśato hāsyārthaṃ pi pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.64. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should hide or have hidden a <s>bhikṣu</s>'s bowl, robe, sitting-cloth, or needle-case — even as a joke — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.65. yo puna bhikṣur bhikṣuṃ bhīṣeya pācattikam /
body.translated_text: Pāc.65. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should frighten a <s>bhikṣu</s> — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.66. udakahastasaṃmardanāt pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.66. For rubbing [another's body] with a hand [full of] water — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.67. aṅgulipratodanake pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.67. For tickling with a finger — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.68. yo puna bhikṣu mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya adhvānamārgaṃ pratipadyeya antamaśato grāmāntaraṃ pi pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.68. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should arrange to travel on a road together with a woman, even to the next village — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.69. yo puna bhikṣu mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdhaṃ sahagāraśayyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.69. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should share a room with a woman — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.70. yo puna bhikṣu mātṛgrāmeṇa sārdhaṃ eko ekāya raho niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: Pāc.70. Whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> should sit in private, alone with a single woman — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: // uddānam //
body.translated_text: // Summary verse //

body.text: (61) saṃcintya (62) kaukṛtyam (63) apratyuddharitvā (64) apaniheya / (65) bhīṣeya (66) udaka (67) aṅguli (68) saṃvidhāya (69) sahagāra (70) niṣadyāya // saptamo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (61) Intentional [concealment], (62) remorse, (63) without retracting, (64) irremovable, (65) frightening, (66) water, (67) finger, (68) having arranged, (69) in the same room, (70) sitting. // Seventh group. //

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.71. yo puna bhikṣur jānan ūnaviṃśativarṣapudgalaṃ bhikṣubhāvāya upasaṃpādeya, so ca pudgalo anupasaṃpanno, te ca bhikṣū gārhyāṃ, imaṃ teṣāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ garhaṇapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 71. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should knowingly confer full ordination on a person less than twenty years of age, that person is not ordained, and those <s>bhikṣu</s>s are blameworthy. For those <s>bhikṣu</s>s, this is a censure-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.72. yo puna bhikṣur jānan stainyasārthena sārdhaṃ saṃvidhāya adhvānamārgaṃ pratipadyeya antamaśato grāmāntaraṃ pi pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 72. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, having arranged [to travel] with a caravan of thieves, should set out on a road-journey, even as far as between one village and another — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.73. yo puna bhikṣuḥ svahastaṃ pṛthivīṃ khaneya vā khanāpeya vā antamaśato iha khanehīti vā vadeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 73. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should dig the earth with his own hand, or cause it to be dug, or even say "dig here" — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.74. cāturmāsikā bhikṣuṇā pratyekapravāraṇā sādayitavyā / taduttariṃ sādiyeya, anyatra punaḥ pravāraṇe, anyatra yāvajjīvikāye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 74. A <s>bhikṣu</s> should accept an individual invitation (<s>pravarāṇā</s>) for four months [at most]. If he accepts beyond that, except when invited again or for a lifelong [invitation] — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.75. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣūhi evaṃ vucyamāno Ō imehi te āyuṣman pañcahi āpattikāyehi anadhyāvācāya śikṣā karaṇīyeti, so bhikṣu tān bhikṣūn evaṃ vadeya Ō na yāvad aham āyuṣmantānāṃ vacanena śikṣiṣyaṃ yāvad ahaṃ na drakṣyāmi sthavirān bhikṣūn sūtradharān vinayadharān mātṛkādharān madhyamān bhikṣūn sūtradharān vinayadharān mātṛkādharān, navakān bhikṣūn sūtradharān vinayadharān mātṛkādharān / tāṃs tāvad aham upasaṃkramya paripṛcchiṣyaṃ paripraśnīkariṣyaṃ ti, pācattikaṃ / śikṣākāmena bhikṣuṇā ājñātavyam upalakṣayitavyaṃ upadhārayitavyaṃ //
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 75. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, being told by <s>bhikṣu</s>s thus: "Venerable one, you must train in non-transgression regarding these five classes of offenses" — and that <s>bhikṣu</s> says to those <s>bhikṣu</s>s: "I shall not train at the venerable ones' word until I have seen elder <s>bhikṣu</s>s who are bearers of the <s>Sūtra</s>, bearers of the <s>Vinaya</s>, bearers of the <s>Mātṛkā</s>; middle-standing <s>bhikṣu</s>s who are bearers of the <s>Sūtra</s>, bearers of the <s>Vinaya</s>, bearers of the <s>Mātṛkā</s>; and newly ordained <s>bhikṣu</s>s who are bearers of the <s>Sūtra</s>, bearers of the <s>Vinaya</s>, bearers of the <s>Mātṛkā</s>. Let me first approach them and ask and inquire" — <s>pācattika</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> who desires to train should understand, examine, and reflect [upon the rules].

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.76. surāmaireyamadya[pānaṃ] pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 76. Drinking <s>surā</s>, <s>maireya</s>, or intoxicating liquor — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.77. bhikṣunādarye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 77. For a <s>bhikṣu</s>'s disrespect — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.78. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣūhi kalahajātehi bhaṇḍanajātehi vigrahavivādāpannehi viharantehi upaśrotrasthāne tiṣṭheya Ō yaṃ ete vadiṣyanti taṃ paścād upasaṃhariṣyāmīti / etad eva pratyayaṃ kṛtvā, ananyam, imaṃ tasya bhikṣusya upaśrotrasthāne pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 78. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, when <s>bhikṣu</s>s who have become quarrelsome, disputatious, and fallen into altercation and controversy are dwelling [together], should stand in a place of eavesdropping, [thinking:] "I shall afterward report what they say" — doing so for this very reason and no other — this is for that <s>bhikṣu</s> an eavesdropping-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.79. yo puna bhikṣuḥ saṃghe viniścayakathāhi vartamānāhi utthāyāsanāt prakrameya santaṃ bhikṣum anāmantrayitvā, anyatra tathārūpe atyāyike karaṇīye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 79. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, when deliberative discussions are taking place in the <s>Saṅgha</s>, should get up from his seat and leave without taking leave of a <s>bhikṣu</s> present, except when there is such an urgent matter to be done — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.80. yo puna bhikṣu āraṇyake śayyāsane viharanto vikāle grāmaṃ praviśeya santaṃ bhikṣum anāmantrayitvā, anyatra tathārūpe atyāyike karaṇīye pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 80. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> dwelling in a forest sleeping-quarters should enter a village at an improper time without taking leave of a <s>bhikṣu</s> present, except when there is such an urgent matter to be done — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: // uddānaṃ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: (71) ūnaviṃśati (72) stainyasārtho (73) pṛthivī (74) pravāraṇā (75) na śikṣiṣyaṃ (76) madyapānam (77) anādaryam (78) upaśrotra (79) viniścaya (80) āraṇyakena // aṣṭamo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (71) Under twenty, (72) caravan of thieves, (73) earth, (74) invitation, (75) "I shall not train," (76) drinking intoxicants, (77) disrespect, (78) eavesdropping, (79) deliberation, (80) with forest[-dwelling]. // Eighth group. //

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.81. yo puna bhikṣu sabhakto samāno purebhaktaṃ paścādbhaktaṃ vā kuleṣu cāritram āpadyeya santaṃ bhikṣum anāmantrayitvā, anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ / tatrāyam samayo Ō cīvaradānakālasamayo / ayam atra samayaḥ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 81. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> who has [already received] his meal should go visiting families before or after the meal without taking leave of a <s>bhikṣu</s> present, except at the proper time — <s>pācattika</s>. The proper time here is: the time of robe-giving. This is the proper time.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.82. yo puna bhikṣu rājñaḥ kṣatriyasya mūrdhābhiṣiktasya janapadasthāmavīryaprāptasya antaḥpuraṃ praviśeyāniṣkrānte rājāne, aniṣkrānte antaḥpure, anirgatehi ratanehi antamaśato indrakīlaṃ pi atikrameya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 82. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should enter the inner quarters of a <s>kṣatriya</s> king who has received the royal consecration, who possesses the power and might of the realm, when the king has not departed, when the inner quarters have not been vacated, when the precious [women] have not withdrawn — should he cross even the threshold — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.83. yo puna bhikṣu dantamayaṃ vā asthimayaṃ vā śṛṅgamayaṃ vā suvarṇamayaṃ vā rūpyamayaṃ vā ratanamayaṃ vā sūcīvigrahaṃ kārāpeya bhedanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 83. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a needle-case made of ivory, bone, horn, gold, silver, or jewels — breaking-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.84. mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena sugatāṣṭāṅgulapramāṇāḥ pādakāḥ kārāpayitavyāḥ anyatrāṭṭanīye, taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 84. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a bed or chair made, the legs should be made to the measure of eight <s>Sugata</s>-finger-breadths [in height], excluding the frame. If he has [them] made higher than that — cutting-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.85. yo puna bhikṣuḥ tūlasaṃstṛte mañce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdeya vā abhi[ni]padyeya vā uddālanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 85. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should sit down on or lie down on a bed or chair stuffed with cotton — tearing-out-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.86. niṣīdanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena prāmāṇikaṃ kārāpayitavyaṃ / tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ Ō dīrghaśo dve vitastīyo sugatavitastinā tiryag dvyardham anyatra daśavitastikaṃ / taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 86. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a sitting-mat made, it should be made to the proper measurement. This is the measurement: two <s>Sugata</s>-spans in length, one and a half in width, with a ten-span border. If he has it made larger than that — cutting-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.87. kaṇḍūpraticchādanaṃ bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena prāmāṇikaṃ kārāpayitavyaṃ / tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ Ō dīrghaśo catvāri vitastīyo sugatavitastinā, tiryag dve / taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 87. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having an itch-covering cloth made, it should be made to the proper measurement. This is the measurement: four <s>Sugata</s>-spans in length, two in width. If he has it made larger than that — cutting-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.88. varṣāśāṭikā bhikṣuṇā kārāpayamāṇena prāmāṇikā kārāpayitavyā / tatredaṃ pramāṇaṃ Ō dīrghaśo ṣaḍvitastīyo sugatavitastinā, tiryag aḍḍhatīyaṃ / taduttariṃ kārāpeya cchedanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 88. When a <s>bhikṣu</s> is having a rain-cloak made, it should be made to the proper measurement. This is the measurement: six <s>Sugata</s>-spans in length, two and a half in width. If he has it made larger than that — cutting-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.89. yo puna bhikṣuḥ sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ cīvaraṃ kārāpeya Ō kiñca tasya bhagavato tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya sugatasya sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ? dirghaśo nava vitastīyo sugatavitastinā, tiryak ṣaṭ / idaṃ tasya bhagavato tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya sugatasya sugatacīvarapramāṇaṃ / tato vā punar uttariṃ kārāpeya cchedanapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 89. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> should have a robe made to the measurement of a <s>Sugata</s>-robe — what then is the robe-measurement of the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, the <s>Sugata</s>? Nine <s>Sugata</s>-spans in length, six in width. This is the robe-measurement of the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, the <s>Sugata</s>. If he should have [a robe] made larger than that — cutting-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.90. yo puna bhikṣu bhikṣusya duṣṭo doṣāt kupito anāttamano amūlakena saṃghātiśeṣeṇa dharmeṇānudhvaṃseya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 90. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, being hostile, angry, and displeased, should charge a <s>bhikṣu</s> with a baseless <s>saṅghātiśeṣa</s> offense — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.91. yo puna bhikṣur jānan sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ saṃghe pariṇataṃ pudgalo pudgalasya pariṇāmeya pācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 91. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, knowingly, should divert to an individual a communal gain that has been apportioned to the <s>Saṅgha</s> — <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pāc.92. yo puna bhikṣur anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddiśyamāne evaṃ vadeya Ō adya punar ahaṃ jānāmi, idānīṃ punar ahaṃ jānāmi Ō ayaṃ pi dharmo sūtrāgato sūtraparyāpanno anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśam āgacchati / yāvad ahaṃ na jānāmi tāvan nāstītthaṃ mahyam āpattir jāneṃsu ca te bhikṣu taṃ bhikṣuṃ sakṛd dvikkhuto trikkhuto āgatapūrvaṃ pi sanniṣaṇṇapūrvaṃ pi, kaḥ punar vādo bahuśo / nāsti kho punas tasya bhikṣusya ajñānena muktiḥ / atha khu yāṃ pi ca so bhikṣur āpattim āpanno tāṃ kṣipram eva yathādharmmaṃ yathāvinayaṃ kārāpayitavyo, uttariṃ ca saṃmoham āpādayitavyo / tasya te āyuṣman lābhā durlabdhā yas tvaṃ anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddiśyamāne nāsthīkṛtvā na manasikṛtvā na sarvacetasā samanvāhṛtya avahitaśroto satkṛtya dharmaṃ śṛṇoṣīti / imaṃ tasya bhikṣusya saṃmohapācattikaṃ /
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> 92. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, when the <s>Sūtra</s> of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> is being recited every half-month, should say thus: "Only now do I know; just now do I understand that this rule too has come down in the <s>Sūtra</s>, is contained in the <s>Sūtra</s>, and comes up for recitation every half-month in the <s>Sūtra</s> of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s>. As long as I did not know, there is no offense for me in this way" — and [if] those <s>bhikṣu</s>s know that <s>bhikṣu</s> to have come once, twice, or three times before, and to have been seated [at the recitation] before, and how much more so many times — there is certainly no release for that <s>bhikṣu</s> on the ground of ignorance. Rather, whatever offense that <s>bhikṣu</s> has committed, he should quickly be dealt with according to the <s>Dharma</s> and according to the <s>Vinaya</s>, and furthermore he should be subjected to [the charge of] delusion: "It is your loss, venerable one, and poorly gained, that when the <s>Sūtra</s> of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> is being recited every half-month, you do not heed, attend, apply your whole mind, and listen to the <s>Dharma</s> with respectful and attentive ears." This is for that <s>bhikṣu</s> a delusion-<s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: // uddānam //
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: (81) sabhakto (82) rājño (83) sūcī gṛhaṃ (84) mañca (85) tūla (86) niṣīdanaṃ / (87) kaṇḍū (88) varṣāśāṭikā (89) sugatacīvaram (90) abhyākhyānaṃ (91) pariṇāmanam (92) ajñānakena // navamo vargaḥ //
body.translated_text: (81) With meal, (82) king's [quarters], (83) needle-case, (84) bed, (85) cotton, (86) sitting-mat, (87) itch-covering, (88) rain-cloak, (89) <s>Sugata</s>-robe, (90) false accusation, (91) diversion, (92) with [feigned] ignorance. // Ninth group. //

body.text: // vargāṇām uddānaṃ //
body.translated_text: Summary verse of the groups (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: (1) mṛṣā (2) bījaṃ (3) asaṃmato (4) ekāhaparamo / (5) jyoti (6) saprāṇakaṃ (7) sañcintya (8) ūnaviṃśati (9) sabhaktakena navamaḥ /
body.translated_text: (1) Falsehood, (2) seed, (3) unauthorized, (4) one day at most, (5) fire, (6) with living beings, (7) intentional, (8) under twenty, (9) with meal — the ninth.

body.text: uddiṣṭāḥ kho punar āyuṣmanto dvānavati śuddhapācattikā dharmāḥ / tatrāyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? dvitīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? tṛtīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the ninety-two pure confession (<s>śuddhapācattika</s>) offenses have been recited. Therein I ask the venerable ones: are you pure in this matter? A second time I ask the venerable ones: are you pure? A third time I ask the venerable ones: are you pure? The venerable ones are pure in this matter; since they are silent, thus I hold it.

body.text: [VI. catvāraḥ prātideśanikā dharmāḥ]
body.translated_text: [VI. The four offenses requiring acknowledgment (<s>prātideśanika dharma</s>s)]

body.text: ime kho punar āyuṣmanto catvāraḥ prātideśanikā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśam āgacchanti Ō
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, these four offenses requiring acknowledgment come up for recitation every half-month in the <s>Sūtra</s> of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s>:

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pratid.1. yo puna bhikṣu āraṇyake śayanāsane viharanto pūrve apratisaṃveditaṃ bahirdhā apratigṛhītaṃ, antovāsavastusminn agilāno svahastaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā pratigṛhṇitvā khādeya vā bhuñjeya vā bhuktāvinā tena bhikṣuṇā pratideśayitavyaṃ Ō asaṃpreyaṃ me āyuṣman gārhyaṃ prātideśanikaṃ dharmam āpanno / taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi / ayaṃ dharmo prātideśaniko //
body.translated_text: <s>Pratideśanīya</s> 1. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, dwelling in a forest sleeping-quarter, should receive with his own hand hard or soft food that has not been previously announced or accepted from outside, within the dwelling, and being not sick, should chew or eat it — that <s>bhikṣu</s>, having eaten, should confess: 'I have, venerable one, committed a blameworthy, unseemly <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense.' This is a <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pratid.2. yo puna bhikṣur anyātikāye bhikṣuṇīye antaragṛhaṃ praviṣṭāye agilāno svahastaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā pratigṛhṇitvā khādeya vā bhuṃjeya vā bhuktāvinā tena bhikṣuṇā pratideśayitavyaṃ Ō asaṃpreyaṃ me āyuṣman gārhyaṃ prātideśanikaṃ dharmam āpanno / taṃ dharmmaṃ pratideśayāmi / ayaṃ pi dharmo prātideśaniko /
body.translated_text: <s>Pratideśanīya</s> 2. If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, being not sick, should receive with his own hand hard or soft food from an unrelated <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who has entered a house, and should chew or eat it — that <s>bhikṣu</s>, having eaten, should confess: 'I have, venerable one, committed a blameworthy, unseemly <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense.' This too is a <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pratid.3. bhikṣu kho punar antaragṛhe nimantritakā bhuñjanti / tatra ca bhikṣuṇī viśvāsamānarūpā sthitā bhavati / sā evam āha Ō iha odanaṃ dehi, iha sūpaṃ dehi, iha vyañjanaṃ dehīti vā vadeya / sarvehi tehi bhikṣuhi sā bhikṣuṇī evam asya vacanīyā Ō āgamaya tāva tvaṃ bhagini yāvad bhikṣū bhuñjantīti / ekabhikṣū pi ca tāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ neva vadeya Ō āgamaya tāva tvaṃ bhagini yāvad bhikṣū bhuñjantīti, bhuktāvīhi tehi bhikṣūhi pratideśayitavyaṃ Ō asaṃpreyaṃ me āyuṣman gārhyaṃ prātideśanikaṃ dharmam āpanno / taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi / ayaṃ pi dharmo prātideśaniko //
body.translated_text: <s>Pratideśanīya</s> 3. When <s>bhikṣus</s> who have been invited are eating in a house, and a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> stands there in a familiar manner, and she says thus: 'Give rice here, give soup here, give side-dishes here' — all those <s>bhikṣus</s> should address that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> thus: 'Wait, sister, until the <s>bhikṣus</s> have finished eating.' If not even one <s>bhikṣu</s> should address that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> [saying]: 'Wait, sister, until the <s>bhikṣus</s> have finished eating' — those <s>bhikṣus</s>, having eaten, should confess: 'I have, venerable one, committed a blameworthy, unseemly <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense.' This too is a <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense.

body.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Pratid.4. yāni kho punar imāni śaikṣasaṃmatāni kulāni bhavanti tatra ca bhikṣuḥ pūrve apravārito upasaṃkramitvā svahastaṃ khādanīyaṃ vā bhojanīyaṃ vā pratigṛhṇitvā khādeya vā bhuñjeya vā bhuktāvinā tena bhikṣuṇā pratideśayitavyaṃ Ō asaṃpreyaṃ me āyuṣman gārhyaṃ prātideśanikaṃ dharmam āpanno / taṃ dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi / ayaṃ pi dharmo prātideśaniko //
body.translated_text: <s>Pratideśanīya</s> 4. There are families that have been designated as 'in training' (<s>śaikṣa</s>). If a <s>bhikṣu</s>, without having been previously invited, should approach [such a family] and, receiving with his own hand hard or soft food, should chew or eat it — that <s>bhikṣu</s>, having eaten, should confess: 'I have, venerable one, committed a blameworthy, unseemly <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense. I confess that offense.' This too is a <s>Pratideśanīya</s> offense.

body.text: // uddānam //
body.translated_text: // Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>) //

body.text: (1) āraṇyakam (2) antaragṛhe (3) bhikṣū ca nimantritakāḥ (4) śaikṣasaṃmatena caturthaḥ //
body.translated_text: (1) Forest, (2) in a house, (3) invited <s>bhikṣus</s>, (4) with the 'in training' [family] is the fourth //

body.text: uddiṣṭāḥ kho punar āyuṣmanto catvāraḥ prātideśanikā dharmāḥ / tatrāyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? dvitīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? tṛtīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the four <s>Pratideśanīya</s> (confession) offenses have been recited. I ask the venerable ones: are you pure in this matter? A second time I ask the venerable ones: are you pure in this matter? A third time I ask the venerable ones: are you pure in this matter? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus I understand it.

body.text: [VII. sātirekapañcāśac chaikṣā dharmāḥ]
body.translated_text: [VII. The fifty-odd <s>Śaikṣa</s> (Training) Rules]

body.text: ime kho punar āyuṣmanto sātirekapañcāśac chaikṣā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśam āgacchanti Ō
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, these fifty-odd <s>Śaikṣa</s> (training) rules come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣasūtra</s> every half-month.

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.1. parimaṇḍalaṃ nivasanaṃ nivāsayiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.2. parimaṇḍalaṃ cīvaraṃ prāvariṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.3. susaṃvṛto antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.4. na utkṣiptacakṣur antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.5. alpaśabdo antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.6. na uccagghikāya antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.7. na oguṇṭhikāya antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.8. na utkṣiptikāya antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.9. na utkuṭukāya antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.10. na khambhakṛto antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.11. na kāyapracālakam antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.12. na śīrṣapracālakam antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Śai.13. na bāhuvikṣepakam antaragṛham upasaṃkramiṣyāmīti śikṣā karaṇīyā /
body.translated_text:
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 1. 'I shall wear the lower robe evenly wrapped around' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 2. 'I shall wear the upper robe evenly wrapped around' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 3. 'I shall enter houses well-covered' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 4. 'I shall enter houses without looking upward' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 5. 'I shall enter houses with little noise' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 6. 'I shall not enter houses with loud laughter' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 7. 'I shall not enter houses with the head covered' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 8. 'I shall not enter houses with the robe lifted up' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 9. 'I shall not enter houses squatting' — this is a training rule.
<s>Śaikṣa</s> 10. 'I shall not enter houses with arms akimbo' — this is a training rule.

<s>Śaikṣa</s> 32. 'I shall not eat alms-food tossing morsels [into the mouth]' — this is a training rule.

body.text: uddiṣṭāḥ kho punar āyuṣmanto sātirekapañcāśac chaikṣā dharmāḥ / tatrāyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? dvitīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? tṛtīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the fifty-odd <s>śaikṣa</s> (training) rules have been recited. Herein, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A second time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A third time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus do I hold it.

body.text: [VIII. sapta adhikaraṇaśamathā dharmāḥ]
body.translated_text: [VIII. The Seven Rules for the Settlement of Disputes (<s>Adhikaraṇaśamatha Dharmāḥ</s>)]

body.text: ime kho punar āyuṣmanto sapta adhikaraṇasamathā dharmā anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśam āgacchanti ye utpannotpannānām adhikaraṇānāṃ śamathāya vyapaśamathāya saṃvartante / sayyathīdaṃ Ō
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, these seven rules for the settlement of disputes come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> every half-month — which conduce to the quieting and settling of disputes that arise. They are as follows:

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā-L)AŚ.1. saṃmukhavinayo śamatho /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)AŚ.2. smṛtivinayo śamatho /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)AŚ.3. amūḍhavinayo śamatho /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)AŚ.4. pratijñākārako śamatho /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)AŚ.5. tasya pāpeyasiko śamatho /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)AŚ.6. yo bhūyasiko śamatho /
PrMoSū(Mā-L)AŚ.7. tṛṇaprastārako ca śamatho saptamo /
body.translated_text:
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>AŚ</s>.1. Face-to-face adjudication (<s>saṃmukhavinaya</s>) is a settlement.
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>AŚ</s>.2. Adjudication by recollection (<s>smṛtivinaya</s>) is a settlement.
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>AŚ</s>.3. Adjudication for [past] insanity (<s>amūḍhavinaya</s>) is a settlement.
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>AŚ</s>.4. Settlement by confession (<s>pratijñākāraka</s>).
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>AŚ</s>.5. Determination of the nature [of the offense] (<s>pāpeyasika</s>) is a settlement.
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>AŚ</s>.6. Decision by majority (<s>bhūyasika</s>) is a settlement.
<s>PrMoSū</s>(Mā-L)<s>AŚ</s>.7. And the procedure of 'spreading grass' (<s>tṛṇaprastāraka</s>) is the seventh settlement.

body.text: uddiṣṭāḥ kho punar āyuṣmanto sapta adhikaraṇaśamathā dharmāḥ / tatrāyuḥmanto pṛcchāmi Ō kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? dvitīyaṃ pi āyuḥmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? tṛtīyaṃ pi āyuḥmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? pariśuddhā atrāyuḥmanto yasmāt tūḥṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the seven rules for the settlement of disputes have been recited. Herein, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A second time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A third time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus do I hold it.

body.text: [IX. duve dharmāḥ]
body.translated_text: [IX. The Two <s>Dharmas</s>]

body.text: ime kho punar āyuṣmanto duve dharmāḥ Ō dharmo anudharmaś ca anvardhamāsaṃ sūtre prātimokṣe uddeśam āgacchanti / tatra dharmo nāma yam ubhayato vinayo / anudharmo nāma yā atra pratipattiḥ /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, these two <s>dharmas</s> — the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Anudharma</s> (subsidiary rule) — come up for recitation in the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> every half-month. Therein, the <s>Dharma</s> is that which constitutes the <s>Vinaya</s> from both sides. The <s>Anudharma</s> is the practice [prescribed] herein.

body.text: uddiṣṭāḥ kho punar āyuṣmanto duve dharmāḥ dharmo anudharmaś ca / tatrāyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi Ō kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? dvitīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? tṛtīyaṃ pi āyuṣmanto pṛcchāmi kaccittha pariśuddhāḥ? pariśuddhā atrāyuṣmanto yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the two <s>dharmas</s> — the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Anudharma</s> — have been recited. Herein, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A second time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? A third time, venerable ones, I ask: Are you pure? The venerable ones are pure in this matter, since they remain silent. Thus do I hold it.

body.text: uddiṣṭaṃ kho punar āyuṣmanto prātimokṣasya vastu / uddiṣṭaṃ nidānaṃ / uddiṣṭāś catvāraḥ pārājikā dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭāḥ trayodaśa saṃghātiśeṣā dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭāḥ duve aniyatā dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭāḥ triṃśan nissargikapācattikā dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭā dvānavati śuddhapācatti[kā] dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭāś catvāraḥ prātideśanikā dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭāḥ sātirekapañcāśac chaikṣā dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭāḥ saptādhikaraṇaśamathā dharmāḥ / uddiṣṭā duve dharmāḥ, dharmo anudharmaś ca / etako 'yaṃ punas tasya bhagavato tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya dharmavinayo prātimokṣasūtrāgato sūtraparyāpanno / yo vā anyo 'pi kaścid dharmasya anudharmo tatra samagrehi sarvehi sahitehi saṃmodamānehi avivadamānehi ekuddeśehi kṣīrodakībhūtehi śāstuḥ śāsanaṃ dīpayamānehi sukhaṃ ca phāsuṃ ca viharantehi anadhyācārāya śikṣā karaṇīyā /
body.translated_text: Venerable ones, the subject matter of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> has been recited. The introduction has been recited. The four <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) rules have been recited. The thirteen <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s> (formal meeting) rules have been recited. The two <s>aniyata</s> (undetermined) rules have been recited. The thirty <s>nissargikapācattika</s> (forfeiture-expiation) rules have been recited. The ninety-two pure <s>pācattika</s> (expiation) rules have been recited. The four <s>prātideśanika</s> (confession) rules have been recited. The more-than-fifty <s>śaikṣa</s> (training) rules have been recited. The seven rules for the settling of disputes (<s>adhikaraṇaśamatha</s>) have been recited. The two [categories of] rules have been recited: the <s>Dharma</s> and the subsidiary <s>Dharma</s>. This is the entirety of the <s>Dharma-Vinaya</s> of the Blessed One, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, as contained in the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s>, as comprised in the <s>Sūtra</s>. And whatever other subsidiary <s>Dharma</s> there may be — therein, [all monks] being united, all being in harmony, rejoicing together, not quarreling, reciting with one voice, becoming like milk and water, illuminating the Teacher's dispensation and dwelling in happiness and comfort, must train for the avoidance of misconduct.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.1.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 1.

children.text: kṣāntiḥ paramaṃ tapo titikṣā nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ vadanti buddhāḥ /
children.translated_text: Patience and forbearance are the supreme austerity; <s>Nirvāṇa</s> is the supreme [state], say the <s>Buddhas</s>;

children.text: na hi pravrajitaḥ paropatāpī śravaṇo bhoti parān viheṭhayānaḥ //
children.translated_text: for one who has gone forth and harms others is not an ascetic; one who injures others is not a <s>śramaṇa</s>.

body.text: idaṃ tasya bhagavato vipaśyisya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya acirābhisaṃbuddhasya nirarbude bhikṣusaṃghe saṃkṣiptena prātimokṣaṃ subhāṣitaṃ /
body.translated_text: This was the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> well-spoken in brief by the Blessed <s>Vipaśyin</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, recently after his awakening, when the <s>bhikṣu</s>-<s>Saṅgha</s> was without dissension.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.2.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 2.

children.text: anopavādī aparopaghātī prātimokṣe ca saṃvaro /
children.translated_text: Not reviling, not harming others, restraint according to the <s>Prātimokṣa</s>,

children.text: mātrajñatā ca bhaktasmiṃ prāntaṃ ca śayanāsanaṃ /
children.translated_text: moderation in food, and secluded lodging,

children.text: adhicitte cāyogo etaṃ buddhānuśāsanaṃ //
children.translated_text: and devotion to the higher mind — this is the instruction of the <s>Buddhas</s>.

body.text: idaṃ tasya bhagavato śikṣisya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya acirābhisaṃbuddhasya nirarbude bhikṣusaṃghe saṃkṣiptena prātimokṣaṃ subhāṣitaṃ //
body.translated_text: This was the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> well-spoken in brief by the Blessed <s>Śikhin</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, recently after his awakening, when the <s>bhikṣu</s>-<s>Saṅgha</s> was without dissension.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.3.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 3.

children.text: adhicetasi mā pramādyato munino maunapadeṣu śikṣataḥ /
children.translated_text: Be not heedless regarding the higher mind, you who train in the sage's path of silence;

children.text: śokā na bhavanti tāyino upaśāntasya sadā smṛtīmataḥ //
children.translated_text: sorrows do not arise for the protector who is at peace and always mindful.

body.text: idaṃ tasya bhagavato viśvabhuvasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya acirābhisaṃbuddhasya nirarbude bhikṣusaṃghe saṃkṣiptena prātimokṣaṃ subhāṣitaṃ //
body.translated_text: This was the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> well-spoken in brief by the Blessed <s>Viśvabhū</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, recently after his awakening, when the <s>bhikṣu</s>-<s>Saṅgha</s> was without dissension.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.4.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 4.

children.text: sarvapāpasyākaraṇaṃ kuśalasyopasaṃpadā /
children.translated_text: The non-doing of all evil, the undertaking of what is wholesome,

children.text: svacittaparyodapanaṃ etaṃ buddhānuśāsanam //
children.translated_text: the purification of one's own mind — this is the instruction of the <s>Buddhas</s>.

body.text: idaṃ tasya bhagavato krakucchandasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya acirābhisaṃbuddhasya nirarbude bhikṣusaṃghe saṃkṣiptena prātimokṣaṃ subhāṣitaṃ //
body.translated_text: This was the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> well-spoken in brief by the Blessed <s>Krakucchanda</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, recently after his awakening, when the <s>bhikṣu</s>-<s>Saṅgha</s> was without dissension.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.5.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 5.

children.text: yathā hi bhramaro puṇyaṃ varṇagandham aheṭhayaṃ /
children.translated_text: Just as a bee, without harming the flower's color and fragrance,

children.text: paraiti rasam ādāya evaṃ grāme muniś caret //
children.translated_text: departs taking [only] the nectar — so should a sage move through the village.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.6.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 6.

children.text: na pareṣāṃ vilomāni na pareṣāṃ kṛtākṛtaṃ /
children.translated_text: Not [looking at] the faults of others, not [examining] what others have done or left undone,

children.text: ātmano tu samīkṣeta kṛtāny akṛtāni ca //
children.translated_text: but one should examine one's own deeds, both done and not done.

body.text: idaṃ tasya bhagavato konākamunisya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya acirābhisaṃbuddhasya nirarbude bhikṣusaṃghe saṃkṣiptena prātimokṣaṃ subhāṣitam /
body.translated_text: This was the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> well-spoken in brief by the Blessed <s>Konākamuni</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, recently after his awakening, when the <s>bhikṣu</s>-<s>Saṅgha</s> was without dissension.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.7.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 7.

children.text: nāsti dhyānam aprajñasya prajñā nāsti adhyāyato /
children.translated_text: There is no meditation without wisdom; there is no wisdom without meditation;

children.text: yasya dhyānaṃ ca prajñā ca sa vai nirvāṇasya antike //
children.translated_text: one in whom there is both meditation and wisdom — he indeed is near to <s>Nirvāṇa</s>.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.8.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 8.

children.text: tatrāyam ādi bhavati ihaprajñasya bhikṣuṇo /
children.translated_text: This is the beginning for the <s>bhikṣu</s> who has wisdom in this [teaching]:

children.text: indriyai guptiḥ saṃtuṣṭiḥ prātimokṣe ca saṃvaro //
children.translated_text: guarding of the sense-faculties, contentment, and restraint according to the <s>Prātimokṣa</s>.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.9.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 9.

children.text: mitraṃ bhajeta kalyāṇaṃ śuddhājīvīm atandritaṃ /
children.translated_text: One should associate with a good friend, of pure livelihood and unwearied;

children.text: pratisaṃstaravartī ca ācārakuśalo siyā /
children.translated_text: one should be courteous in conduct and skilled in behavior;

children.text: tataḥ prāmodya bahulo bhikṣu nirvāṇasyaiva antike //
children.translated_text: then the <s>bhikṣu</s>, full of joy, is indeed near to <s>Nirvāṇa</s>.

body.text: idaṃ tasya bhagavataḥ kāśyapasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhasya acirābhisaṃbuddhasya nirarbude bhikṣusaṃghe saṃkṣiptena prātimokṣaṃ subhāṣitam //
body.translated_text: This was the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> well-spoken in brief by the Blessed <s>Kāśyapa</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, recently after his awakening, when the <s>bhikṣu</s>-<s>Saṅgha</s> was without dissension.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.10.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 10.

children.text: cakṣuṣā saṃvaraḥ sādhuḥ sādhuḥ śrotreṇa saṃvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: Good is restraint by the eye; good is restraint by the ear;

children.text: ghrāṇena saṃvaraḥ sādhuḥ sādhuḥ jihvāya saṃvaraḥ //
children.translated_text: good is restraint by the nose; good is restraint by the tongue.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.11.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 11.

children.text: kāyena saṃvaraḥ sādhuḥ manasā sādhu saṃvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: Good is restraint by the body; good is restraint by the mind;

children.text: sarvatra saṃvṛto bhikṣuḥ sarvaduḥkhāt pramucyate //
children.translated_text: a <s>bhikṣu</s> restrained in all [faculties] is freed from all suffering.

body.text: idaṃ tasya bhagavataḥ śākyamuneḥ śākyādhirājasya tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksambuddhasya acirābhisaṃbuddhasya nirarbude bhikṣusaṃghe saṃkṣiptena prātimokṣaṃ subhāṣitam /
body.translated_text: This was the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> well-spoken in brief by the Blessed <s>Śākyamuni</s>, the supreme lord of the <s>Śākyas</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, recently after his awakening, when the <s>bhikṣu</s>-<s>Saṅgha</s> was without dissension.

children.text: PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.12.
children.translated_text: Concluding Verse 12.

children.text: etāni prātimokṣāṇi saṃbuddhānāṃ śirīmatāṃ /
children.translated_text: These <s>Prātimokṣas</s> of the glorious Perfectly Awakened Ones,

children.text: kīrtitāny aprameyāṇi ........... tiṣṭam a ......... ṇāś ca //
children.translated_text: immeasurable [in number], have been proclaimed ... standing ... and ...

body.text:
PrMoSū(Mā-L)Schlußv.13.
kṣāntivādī ca bhagavān vipaśyī
anopavadyaṃ ca śikhī prakāśayati /
adhicittaṃ ca viśvabhūḥ
akaraṇaṃ ca pāpānāṃ krakucchandaḥ /

children.text: caryāṃ ca konākamuniḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Konākamuni</s> [taught] conduct,

children.text: dhyānāni ca kāśyapo prakāśayati /
children.translated_text: and <s>Kāśyapa</s> proclaimed meditation;

children.text: saṃvaraṃ śākyamuniḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Śākyamuni</s> [taught] restraint.

body.translated_text: Concluding Verse 13. The Blessed <s>Vipaśyin</s> taught patience; <s>Śikhin</s> proclaimed blamelessness;

body.text: ete sapta daśabalā mahāprajñā amitabuddhī saptānāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānām abhinnān .... lokākhyādhipatīnāṃ dharmākhyānāni uktāni /
body.translated_text: These seven, possessing the ten powers, of great wisdom, of immeasurable understanding — the <s>Dharma</s>-proclamations of these seven Perfectly Awakened Ones, the unequaled ... lords of the world, have been spoken.

body.text: uddistaṃ prātimokṣasūtraṃ / kṛtaṃ saṃghena poṣadhaṃ / āryāḥ śikṣāṃ ciraṃ pālayantu / śāsanaṃ .... santu saṃsthātu /
body.translated_text: The <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> has been recited. The <s>Poṣadha</s> has been performed by the <s>Saṅgha</s>. May the noble ones guard the training for a long time. May the dispensation ... long endure.

body.text: samāptaṃ prātimokṣasūtraṃ āryamahāsāṃghikānāṃ lokottaravādināṃ madhyoddeśikānāṃ pāṭha iti //
body.translated_text: The <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s> is complete — the recension of the noble <s>Mahāsāṅghikas</s>, the <s>Lokottaravādins</s>, of the Middle Region.

body.text:
ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetuṃ pi teṣāṃ tathāgato hy avadat* /
teṣāṃ ca yo nirodha evaṃvādī mahāśravaṇaḥ /
body.translated_text: Those <s>dharmas</s> which arise from a cause — the <s>Tathāgata</s> has declared their cause, and also their cessation. Thus speaks the Great Ascetic.

children.text: yo dharmo 'yaṃ pravaramahāyānayayisya śākyabhikṣuloka śrī[dharasya] /
children.translated_text: This <s>Dharma</s> belongs to the excellent <s>Mahāyāna</s> ... of the <s>Śākya</s> <s>bhikṣu</s> world, the glorious [<s>Dhara</s>].

children.text: śākyabhikṣuśrīvijayabhadralikhitam idam //
children.translated_text: This was written by the <s>Śākya</s> <s>bhikṣu</s> <s>Śrīvijayabhadra</s>.
